baseline.model: 100-tree Extra Trees; seven original features; threshold 0.5

feature_audit.association_method: bias-corrected Cramer's V against binary target, computed independently on a fixed random sample of training-side rows within each saved grouped fold; numeric features discretized into training-sample deciles

Killed.reason: WOO and OPO map to detected=1; Survivor maps to 0.

Origin_program.reason: Origin grouping is held out to prevent sibling-record leakage; identifier could allow memorization.

Unnamed: 0.reason: Not a semantic feature and can encode data ordering.

Position_int.definition: Integer mutation-position value parsed into the local CSV. It is available at prediction time, but its scale exceeds gate count on some records; a direct ratio to gates is not assumed valid.

algorithm.definition: Algorithm family associated with the original circuit.

algorithm_group.definition: QMutBench source grouping of algorithm names; likely redundant with algorithm and not part of the selected schema.

dominant_state.definition: QMutBench source category indicating whether the original circuit has a dominant output state.

gate.definition: Quantum gate named by the mutation metadata.

gates.definition: Original-circuit gate count in the dataset metadata.

operation.definition: Mutation operator: Add, Remove, or Replace.

position.definition: QMutBench source field documented as Position (Circuit %), stored in ten percentage bands.

qubits.definition: Number of qubits in the original circuit metadata.

feature_audit.interpretation: Associations are descriptive, univariate training-partition statistics. They do not establish causality or independent predictive gain; model value is judged by grouped held-fold experiments.
feature_audit.source_documentation: data/qmutbench_full/README.md describes position as circuit percent and lists operator, gate, algorithm, and qubit metadata.

feature_definition.position_fraction: midpoint of the QMutBench source Position (Circuit %) band divided by 100; deterministic from inference-time metadata, no target-based encoding

limitations: The three grouped validation folds share the same 305 development origins; results do not establish performance on new external origins.
Origin-level performance still varies; 248 of 305 origins improved at threshold 0.5, so 57 did not.
Probabilities remain uncalibrated model probabilities; improved Brier score is not a calibration guarantee.
The historical 70-origin test was previously examined and was not used in this phase.
The 85% macro F1 target was not reached.

previous_full_development_comparisons.decision: no material difference from selected model
previous_full_development_comparisons.name: Extra Trees, no class weights

research_scope: Historical QMutBench mutation-outcome prediction only; no hardware-noise detection, fault localization, or simulator diagnosis claim.

selected_model.name: 100-tree Extra Trees with source-derived circuit-position fraction
selected_model.training_scope: all development rows only; historical frozen-test origins excluded

source.historical_frozen_test: excluded from feature, threshold, and model selection

full_oof_macro_f1_selected_threshold_des.selection_bias_note: same OOF predictions were used to choose and score this threshold; nested fold results are the less-biased assessment

nested_grouped_results.note: Final OOF thresholds are for a future deployment fit only; same-OOF metrics are descriptive and not unbiased performance estimates.
nested_grouped_results.objective: Nested leave-one-development-fold-out threshold selection; each fold threshold fitted only on the other two folds

threshold_selection.reason: Nested fold thresholds (0.495, 0.460, 0.480) did not improve mean held-fold macro F1 over using 0.5 directly; the all-OOF selected threshold is optimistic.
